forget.confirmMessage: This browser will be removed from your account and all wallet data stored on it will be deleted. The removal is recorded in your account's public log, and the account's encrypted data is re-keyed first, so nothing written from now on is readable from this browser's leftovers. Your account itself is untouched -- logging in again reconnects this browser as new.
forget.confirmCeiling: What cannot be taken back: data this browser already fetched may remain recoverable from the device by forensic means, and the browser profile itself keeps a trace that a wallet was used here. This may take a moment -- keep this tab open.
forget.progress: Forgetting this browser -- re-keying the account and writing the removal. Keep this tab open.
forget.lastClientMessage: This is the only browser connected to this account. Forgetting it removes the browser from the account and deletes all wallet data stored on it, leaving the account with no connected browser: it stays anchored by your passphrase and passkeys alone, the same state a brand-new account starts in. The transition is recorded in your account's public log, and the account's encrypted data is re-keyed first.
forget.lastClientConsequence: Nothing is lost. Any browser can still open the account with the passphrase or passkey you used here -- as a public-computer session that leaves nothing behind, or remembered as a connected browser again. Recovery codes and other sign-in methods keep working; their records are re-sealed before this browser is removed.
forget.lastClientProgress: Forgetting this browser -- re-keying the account, re-anchoring it on your sign-in credentials, and writing the removal. Keep this tab open.
forget.recordsUnreachable: Forgetting this browser stopped before the removal: the sign-in records for {{methods}} could not be updated, and this is the last browser that can update them. Nothing was lost and this browser is still connected -- try again; it picks up where it stopped.
forget.lastClientNow: This browser is now the only one connected to the account, so forgetting it is the transition described above. Confirm again to continue.
forget.failed: Forgetting this browser did not finish. Nothing was lost -- try again; it picks up where it stopped.

recovery.intro: A recovery code can restore access to this wallet from any browser if you lose your passphrase and every connected browser. Each code works exactly once and can be revoked here at any time -- revoking really retires it, everywhere.
recovery.requiresEnrolledClient: Generating recovery codes requires a fully enrolled wallet client on a storage server; this session cannot issue them.
recovery.none: No recovery codes have been generated yet.
recovery.healthWarning: A flagged code may no longer be able to recover this wallet (the browser that issued it has changed). Revoke it and generate a fresh one.
recovery.removeConfirm: Revoke this recovery code? It will stop working everywhere, immediately, and this cannot be undone.
recovery.shownOnce: This code is shown only once. Save it somewhere safe (a password manager, or printed) before confirming.
recovery.codePowerHint: Anyone holding this code can take over the wallet from any browser -- but using it always leaves a visible, permanent record, retires the code, and rotates the account keys.
recovery.saveError: The recovery code could not be created. Nothing was saved -- please try again.
recovery.revokeError: The recovery code could not be revoked. Please try again.

errors.keyringForged: The storage server returned a login record that is not authentic -- it was not written by your passphrase, so it has been forged or tampered with. Sign-in was stopped and nothing was changed. Contact your storage provider, and use a recovery code to reach your account from a trusted server.
errors.keyringRolledBack: The storage server returned an out-of-date login record -- older than the newest one this browser has already accepted. Sign-in was stopped and nothing was changed. Try again; if it keeps happening, the server may be withholding your latest account details.
errors.accountLogContinuity: The storage server returned a version of your account's history that conflicts with what this browser has already verified, so sign-in was stopped as a precaution. Nothing was changed. If you did not expect this, contact your storage provider.
errors.userKeyRosterContinuity: The storage server returned an older version of your account's key list than this browser has already seen, so sign-in was stopped as a precaution. Nothing was changed. If you did not expect this, contact your storage provider.
errors.userKeyRosterIntegrity: The storage server returned an account key list that failed its integrity check, so sign-in was stopped as a precaution. Nothing was changed. If you did not expect this, contact your storage provider.
errors.userKeyRosterUnwrap: This browser is connected to your account, but its copy of your account key is missing -- a setup that was interrupted partway can leave it this way. Use "Connect this browser" below to connect it again from a browser where your wallet is already set up. If you logged in with a passkey, enter your passphrase first.
errors.storageUnreachable: Could not reach the storage server. While we're fixing it, try <guest>guest mode</guest>.
errors.ladderAttribution: Your account was found, but this login method's standing on the account could not be confirmed -- it may have been removed, or the account's published history is in an unexpected state. forget.button: Forget wallet data on this browser
forget.title: Forget all wallet data on this browser?
forget.body: This deletes all locally stored wallet data on this browser, for every account that was ever remembered here. No account is lost: logging in again with a passphrase or passkey reconnects it.
forget.blastRadius: Because it covers the whole browser, other accounts remembered here are affected too -- their local safety checks reset, as if this browser were seeing them for the first time.

recover.intro: Enter a recovery code you saved earlier. The code locates your wallet account and lets this browser join it as a new, fully enrolled client -- no passphrase needed.
recover.noCodeHint: If you never generated a recovery code, your wallet cannot be recovered this way -- a code is created ahead of time from Settings > Recovery codes in a logged-in wallet. Codes are the only recovery path: nothing about your account can be reconstructed from a passphrase alone.
